authority.license_type: Agency to Provide Personal Care Services in the Home
authority.regulatory_scope: Non-medical personal care / ADL support in the client's home

policy.license_truth: License identity, status, expiration and disciplinary evidence come from HCQC/ALiS only.
policy.operational_truth: Minimum hours, pricing, caregiver continuity, W-2/1099 model, insurance, service area, languages, availability and community partnerships require separate direct evidence.
policy.unknown_rule: Missing operational evidence remains UNKNOWN. It is never inferred from licensure or marketing category.
policy.facility_link_rule: A relationship between an Independent Living community and a PCA is stored only when the community or agency directly verifies preferred/on-site/required access. Otherwise outside-care compatibility and agency relationship remain UNKNOWN.
